The Invenio difference

One team, from the first conversation to the last departure.

We are not a listing site. We meet every owner, visit every house and agree the season together — then carry the work that follows: licensing, photography, pricing, calendars, contracts, guests and the small emergencies that happen at eleven at night.

Natalia Szpunar · Managing Partner

Why owners choose us

Four things we take personally.

  • 01

    Revenue, not just occupancy

    A pricing model built around the house, the week and the client — not a race to the bottom. We protect the rate and the property.

  • 02

    The right exposure

    A curated network of agencies and concierges, plus the Invenio platform. Your house is presented to people who will look after it.

  • 03

    One person who knows

    A named account manager for your property, on the island, with the authority to make a decision and the knowledge to make the right one.

  • 04

    Clear numbers, on time

    Transparent reporting, agreed commissions and payouts that arrive when they should. No surprises at the end of the season.

What we handle

How it works

Four steps, then we get out of the way.

  1. 01

    A conversation

    Tell us about the house, the season and what good looks like. We will be honest about whether we are the right fit.

  2. 02

    A visit

    We come and see it — the light, the layout, the road, the neighbours. Licensing and paperwork reviewed before anything is promised.

  3. 03

    The house, presented

    Photography, film and copy that do the property justice. Rates and calendar agreed. The listing goes live to our network.

  4. 04

    The season

    A named manager, 24-hour support and a monthly report. We handle the details; you enjoy the house when you want it.

Questions

The things owners ask us first.

Not answered here? Write to find@inveniohomes.com.

Do I need a tourist licence?+

For a legal short-term rental in the Balearics, yes. We review the property's status before we take it on, explain what is required, and can introduce the specialists we work with. We do not list unlicensed houses.

What commission do you charge?+

It depends on the level of service and the season, and we agree it in writing before the listing goes live. There are no hidden fees; the commission covers distribution, account management, guest support and reporting.

Can I still use the house myself?+

Of course. You tell us the weeks you want, and we block them before the season is published. Most owners keep several weeks, including the ones that matter most.

Who looks after the property?+

Your account manager coordinates housekeeping, linen, pool and garden, and a trusted maintenance team. For larger houses we can arrange a resident house manager.

How quickly will I be paid?+

Payouts are made on an agreed schedule, usually within seven days of departure, with a statement that shows every booking, fee and deduction.

What if I already work with agencies?+

Good. We can work alongside them. Many owners use Invenio for distribution and support while keeping existing relationships — we will be transparent about where the bookings come from.

Next step

Let's look at the house together.

Send us the address, the number of bedrooms and the weeks you would like to keep. We will come back within one working day.
